facts.text: Eat up, boys. We drill the rock, save the world, and I'll be home for the rest.
facts.why: Not a Harry line. The quote page has him saying 'The United States Government just asked us to save the world. Anyone wanna say no?' Printed in quote marks and signed Harry Stamper.
facts.fix: The United States Government just asked us to save the world. Anyone wanna say no?
